{{Quote|But the New Republic can't afford to lose any ships at the moment. However, you might try over at the Amorris system. Last I heard, the Cavrilhu pirate gang was using that as a base, and they're always in need of expert maintenance people.|Lando Calrissian to Niles Ferrier upon catching him stealing a New Republic ship|<ref name="DFR" />}}
The '''Amorris system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] section of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Amorris]] and astronomical object [[Morr Three]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet had become situated within Imperial space and had also become occupied by the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]].

==Description==
The Amorris system was located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Amorris]]<ref name="DFR" /> and the celestial body [[Morr Three]].<ref name="TTTS" />

==History==
[[File:Niles_Ferrier.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Niles Ferrier, who stole several patrol ships from the pirate base on Morr Three]]
Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="BBY Date">''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' states that the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] began their settlement in the Amorris [[Star system/Legends|system]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] held a number of bases on Amorris and Morr Three,<ref name="DFR" /> from which they carried out several raids in the system.<ref name="TTTS" /> In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated within the core territory held by the [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]].<ref name="TEA" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] caught the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Niles Ferrier]] attempting to steal a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] vessel from the [[Sluis Van Shipyards|shipyards]] at the planet [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]]. In the ensuing confrontation, Calrissian suggested that instead of stealing from the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], Ferrier could try targeting the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the Amorris system.<ref name="DFR" /> After the Cavrilhu pirates stole three [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]]s<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|112|Cavrllhu pirates}}</ref> from the New Republic, Ferrier traveled to Morr Three, where the [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol ships]] were held, and stole them.<ref name="TTTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Amorris system was first mentioned in the [[1992]] novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] as the second installment in ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''.<ref name="DFR" /> The system first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], developed by [[Coolhand Interactive]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> The [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Amorris system in grid square O-6,<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Email" /> co-author of that book,<ref name="TEA" /> confirmed during the development of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' that Morr Three was located in the system.<ref name="Email" />
